Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the 30-minute call today. Quick recap and three asks so we can turn the conversation into a concrete plan: 

Recap (what we heard)
- You’re evaluating Redwood to replace a mix of in-house inference and a managed endpoint for production inference workloads (batch and low-latency API).
- Procurement path: legal review -> security questionnaire (SOC 2 evidence) -> finance for PO issuance.
- Preference: PO for initial purchase; team is interested in AWS Marketplace option for future procurement cadence.

Primary asks / next steps
1) Procurement owner: can you confirm the finance contact who will own PO issuance (you mentioned "ap_finance@frostline.ai").
2) Procurement instrument: confirm PO vs. corporate card for initial order and whether marketplace is a blocker.
3) Timeline: do you have target dates for legal review and security review completion? If you share a rough ETA we’ll align our MAP milestones.

Attached: Redwood-Standard-MPA-v1.pdf (our standard mutual action plan + timelines) and a quick MAP template for you to edit (Frostline-MAP-template.xlsx).

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Day 0: Signed SOW / agreed commercial terms
- Day 3–7: Legal + contract redlines
- Day 7–14: Security questionnaire + evidence exchange (SOC 2, network diagram)
- Day 14–21: Finance issues PO / completes marketplace procurement
- Week 4: Provisioning + first integration run

If that looks reasonable I’ll draft a MAP with dates and loop in Lauren (solutions) and Ben (sales ops) to prepare billing and SOW.

Thanks — quick replies to the three asks above would be great.

—
